text:
Ana Patel: Quick q — we need to sync on the pricing signal for the hybrid listing (AWS Marketplace + HW bundle). Can we avoid double-discounting on private offers?
Mike Chen: Yep. Main ask from partners is a simple committed spend ladder + HW rebate. But marketplace wants a flat private-offer discount.
Sara López: From SI POV, customers want clear renewal credits if they hit commit. Complexity kills adoption.
Jordan Kim: Proposal: marketplace private offer = base discount tier; HW partner rebate applied post-invoice as a separate credit (not stacked at listing time). Keeps UI simple.
Ana Patel: That could work. How do we show effective price in the marketplace UI? We can't surface post-invoice rebates there.
Mike Chen: Show two numbers: "list price with marketplace PO" and "estimated effective price w/partner rebate" with a tooltip. Tooltip links to terms.
Marketplace Bot: Listing health check: private_offer_allowed=true, partner_sku_link=ok, metadata_tags=["hw-bundle","si-accelerator"].
Devon (legal): Need to ensure rebate flow doesn't create a second implied discount in the PO legal text. We'll require an addendum referencing the post-invoice credit schedule.
Sara López: Timeline constraints: SI launch on 05/12. Marketplace listing needs to be live 05/04 to run co-marketing.
Jordan Kim: Operational checklist (rough):
```
- Create PO in marketplace (base discount 18%)
- HW rebate contract (3-tier usage trigger)
- Addendum doc for rebate process
- SKU mapping file for billing team
```
Ana Patel: Can billing support map SKU -> rebate code automatically so credits flow without manual ops?
Mike Chen: Yes, but we need a stable mapping file. I'll draft a sample and ping finance.
Devon (legal): Also: renewals. If customer renews and converts to reserved capacity, rebate still applies? Need to cap overlap.
Sara López: Customers expect renewal credit runway. Suggest: allow rebate within first 12 months post-PO, then revisit. Keeps sales pitches simple.
Jordan Kim: Discount tiers suggestion for PO: ["< $100k": 10%, "$100k-$500k": 15%, ">= $500k": 20%]. HW rebate tiers independent, e.g., 2%/3%/5% applied as credit.
Ana Patel: That tiering sounds reasonable. Who owns final numbers? Partnerships + Finance jointly.
Mike Chen: I'll set up a quick spreadsheet with projected unit economics for the three bands.
Marketplace Bot: Reminder: marketplace listing review queue ETA 48h after submission.
Devon (legal): I'll draft the addendum template by EOD tomorrow. Ping me for examples of prior addenda.
Sara López: OK I'll confirm SI readiness 05/08 and call out any integration gaps.
Ana Patel: Perfect. Next steps: Mike -> economics sheet, Jordan -> SKU mapping, Devon -> addendum, Sara -> SI readiness. Reconcile in this thread by 05/01.
Mike Chen: On it.
Jordan Kim: Will prepare mapping and a sample API payload for billing.
Sara López: Thanks, will update.
Devon (legal): noted :thumbsup:
Ana Patel: Thanks all. Keeping marketing brief light — we call it the "Hybrid FastStart Bundle" in comms (ok to use internally until sign-off).
Marketplace Bot: Channel activity logged.
